title: Encoded Polyline Tools
description: Encode latitude/longitude pairs or decode Google-style encoded polylines. Coordinates are [latitude, longitude], bounded to [-90,90] and [-180,180]. Precision defaults to 5 and supports 0–10 decimal places; encoding rounds ties away from zero. At most 10000 points and 200000 encoded characters. Empty routes are allowed. Invalid inputs return valid:false with error and message; incomplete and overlong varints are rejected. Precision is not embedded in the string and must match when decoding.
